label: ask for an opinion, and give one
note: Covered by productive combination, not by a single lesson: `sochna` is introduced, and the habitual template is introduced as applying to any stem, so `ap kya sochte hain?` is buildable from taught parts. Attaching the OPINION ITSELF is not -- that needs `ki`, and HI-A1-CJ-04 records it as missing.
